messages:
Anna P: Quick sync idea — pilot to certify LangChain Runner + LlamaIndex read adapters with an SI (FlowWeave) and do an Aixia HW perf bakeoff next quarter. Need owners.
Ben S: 👍 love it. timeline?
Maria L: Q3 week 2 window looks doable. do we want a soft launch then a co-announce?
Keith R: technically we'll need quantization profiles + KV/cache tuning. can spare 2 engineers for perf runs.
Anna P: @Keith R thanks — please capture runbook items. @Ben S can you own SI playbook and docs? @Maria L handle comms?
Ben S: got it. SI onboarding checklist I'm drafting now. minimal requirements: sandbox creds, sample corpus, perf harness, support handoff.
Maria L: prefer soft launch -> gather metrics -> then marketplace + PR. hold off big PR with HW partner until perf passes.
DevBot: CI pipeline build #542 finished — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/542 :white_check_mark:
Keith R: Perf targets proposal: p95 latency <200ms for 2k tokens, throughput >120 reqs/sec sustained on Aixia A100x8 equiv. need confirmation from HW.
Anna P: I'll ping Aixia (Sam) for availability and exact SKU. @Ben S please map marketplace procurement requirements (contracts, billing, listing metadata).
Ben S: pinged Sam via email just now. copying internal checklist snippet: ```- sandbox creds
- sample corpus
- perf harness
- integration test plan
- ops runbook```
Maria L: also flag: private deployment security review required. I'll loop in security separately.
Keith R: plan for perf baseline: LlamaIndex + FAISS, quantized model path, end-to-end infra + tracing. estimate 2 full days on Aixia hardware per model config.
Anna P: Next steps and owners: @Ben S = SI playbook & marketplace listing, @Keith R = perf & test harness, @Maria L = comms & security gating, me = partner MOU + kickoff.
Ben S: rough timeline = 3w baseline + onboarding, 2w perf validation, 1w docs/listing -> ~6w total.
Maria L: OK. can we schedule a kickoff meeting?
Anna P: setting calendar for next Tue 10am PT. agenda: scope, deliverables, success metrics, comms cadence, rollback.
Ben S: add to agenda: SLAs, support handoff doc, partner escalation path.
Keith R: add to agenda: repo + CI badge for perf green, acceptance tests.
Anna P: perfect. thanks all :rocket:
Ben S: will start SI checklist doc in confluence and share link before kickoff.
Maria L: I'll draft comms playbook and sample marketplace listing copy (short + technical bullets).
Anna P: I'll draft a one-page partner MOU skeleton and share for review before kickoff.
DevBot: Reminder: deploy window next Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC — may affect perf runs.
Anna P: noted. we'll avoid heavy perf during that window. thanks everyone :pray:
